Tanzim Nur Mahir Both of them teach really well. If you attend all the classes, it’s pretty easy to get a good grade.
MUK sir gives 5 questions in the mid and final—you have to answer any 3. He takes 3 quizzes but only counts the best 2. No MCQs. One downside is that he doesn’t curve (at least he didn’t when I took the course), but his questions are set in a way that if you follow his lectures properly, you can easily get full marks.
Same for MAR3 sir. You just have to attend every class and take proper notes. He really emphasises reading the book. From each chapter, he picks out a few math problems, just practice those and you’re good to go. He also doesn’t curve.
